_doc: The glossary at the foot of the front page.
terms: comma's driving model 96244b1f_12800 (N16 nav), 406M parameters, with navigation inputs. The model on the truck.
push
the simulated truck moved 1.0 or 1.5 m sideways off its recorded path; the model must bring it back.
recovery
the share of pushes the model returns from: back within 0.3 m for 1 s, inside a safe corridor, still moving.
bench8
the closed-loop simulator built here: the model steers a simulated G55 while the camera view is redrawn from recorded frames.
open loop (OL)
the model watches a recorded drive; its requests are compared with what the truck did next.
closed loop (CL)
the model drives a simulated G55 in comma's world model; scored by distance from the driver's recorded path.
worldmodel-4B
comma's video model that draws the next camera frames for a given motion.
residual
a small learned correction added to a frozen model's steering output.
window
a stretch of a recorded drive used as one test case. Intervals resample whole drives.
KOEO
key on, engine off: ignition in position 2.
CAN-C, CAN-B
the W463's powertrain and chassis bus (500 kbit/s) and its fault-tolerant body bus (83.3 kbit/s).
Ultimate-NAG52
an open-source replacement for the 722.6 transmission's EGS52 controller.
